items.headline: Weaver throws 2 TD passes, San Jose State wins 6th straight against Hawaii, 20-16
items.description: — Luke Weaver was 19-of-28 passing for 246 yards and two touchdowns with no interceptions and San Jose State beat Hawaii 20-16 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Holman and Harris combine for 3 TDs as Wyoming downs Hawaii 27-10
items.description: — Markell Holman rushed for 87 yards and two touchdowns, and Samuel Harris added 94 yards and a score as Wyoming beat Hawaii 27-10 on Saturday in its Mountain West opener.
